verses.text: Alb'ilkan juntzanh lolonel tik yuj lum tzinan lu'um t'a sti' ha' mar: Icha junok chakxuxum ik' tzek' t'a lum Neguev, icha chi' ol aj skot heb' milwajum t'a lum tzinan lu'um te ay smay.

Ayxo smay jun tas sch'ox Dios wil tik: Ay heb' smeltzajoch yak' chukal t'a yetanimail. Ha heb' milwajum, smilwajnhej heb'. Ex aj Elam yet' ex aj Media, b'at ochanhek hoyan t'a spatik chonhab' Babilonia, tzeyak'an owal yet'ok. Ha Jehová ix ak'an sti' to ol yak' lajwok yaelal ix yak'och jun nación chi'.
Yuj tas ix wil chi' tzin ek' b'akb'on yuj wab'an syail icha tz'aj junok ix ix tz'alji yune'. Ha yuj tas swab' chi' tzin somchajchaanh, yuj tas swil chi' manhxo in animaok swab'i.

Toxonhej somson yol in jolom, tzin ib'xi yuj xiwelal. Te chukxonhej in k'ool swab' yuj tas ay smay. Junjun k'u, ayik numnonxo sk'ik'b'i, tzin te tzalaj wal, palta haxo tiknaik, toxonhej tzin te xiw yuj tas swil tik.

Ix wilani, toxo ix b'o juntzanh mexa, wach'xopax yaj b'aj tz'em k'ojan heb' awtab'il. Wan swa heb', syuk'an ha' heb', haxo t'a jun rato chi', ix och jun aw icha tik: Ex yajalil heb' soldado, ak'ek lista he b'a yet' he maklab' jul-lab', xchi ix wab'i.
Ha Jehová ix halan t'ayin icha tik: Ixik, ak'och junok makwajum, yik wach' syal masanil tas syila'.
Ayik syilan winh skot junok carruaje tok'b'il yuj chawanhok nok' chej, mato ay anima ayk'e t'a yib'anh nok' b'uru, ma t'a yib'anh nok' camello, scham wal yilan winh tas yaji, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ha jun winh makwajum chi', ix el yaw winh ix yalan winh: Ha b'aj tzin maklej tik Mamin, ayinnhej ek' t'a junjun k'u yet' t'a junjun ak'wal, tzin makwaji.

Haxo tiknaik, swil skot jun carruaje tok'b'il yuj chawanh nok' chej, a jun mach ayk'e t'a yol carruaje chi', a tz'alan icha tik: Ix ak'ji ganar Babilonia. Ix sateli. Masanil skomon diosal heb' ix pojb'ati, chok' ix ajkanem t'a sat lu'um, xchi, xchi winh makwajum chi'.
Ab'ek ex wetchonhab', a ex ix ex tek'jiem icha ixim trigo yuj heb' aj Babilonia chi', a tas ix wal tik t'ayex, haton tas ix wab' yuj Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik.
Haton lolonel tik alb'ilkan t'a yib'anh Edom: Ay junok heb' aj Edom chi' ix awajkot t'ayin: ¿Jantakto sk'an sakb'i ach makwajum? ¿Jayeto hora k'ik'to? xchi.
Ix in tak'wi icha tik: Wanxo sakb'i, palta elanhchamel ol k'ik'b'okxi. Tato tza nib'ej tza k'anb'ejxi, ixik ol xo ul a k'anb'ejxi, xin chi t'ay.
Haton juntzanh tik alb'ilkan t'a yib'anh Arabia: Ex chonhwajum aj Dedán, a ex tzex waykan t'a kaltak te' t'a Arabia,
elanhek he cha heb' ay stakinhtial, tzeyak'an ha' yuk'ej heb'. Ha ex kajan ex t'a chonhab' Tema, elanhek b'aj tzek' heb' sb'at elelal, tzeyaltan wael t'a heb'.
Yujto wan yel heb' elelal t'a k'een espada te jay ye yet' jul-lab' wan sjuljieli, haton b'aj ow yak'an owal.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Yik wal jun ab'il tiknaik, icha tz'aj sb'isan stiempo junok munlajwum, a wal ta' ol satel sniwanil yelk'och chonhab' Cedar.
Ha heb' aj Cedar jelan sjulwaji, jaywanhxonhej heb' ol kanok. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in a ex israel ex tik, a in swala', xchi.
